name: Arcane Strike
description: As a swift action, your weapons deal +1 damage for 1 round and count as magic against damage reduction. The bonus rises by 1 per five caster levels, to +5 at 20th.

name: Channel Smite
description: Spend a channel energy use as a swift action before a melee attack to add the channeled damage to a hit on an undead (positive) or living (negative) target. The target can make a Will save to halve it. A miss wastes the use.

name: Combat Casting
description: +4 bonus on concentration checks to cast defensively or while grappled.

name: Deadly Aim
description: Take a -1 penalty on ranged attack rolls for +2 damage. The trade grows as your base attack bonus rises.

name: Spellbreaker
description: Enemies in your threatened area that fail to cast defensively provoke attacks of opportunity from you.

name: Sickening Critical
description: Your critical hits make the target sickened for 1 minute.

name: Staggering Critical
description: Your critical hits stagger the target for 1d4+1 rounds. A Fortitude save reduces this to 1 round.

name: Tiring Critical
description: Your critical hits make the target fatigued.

name: Deafening Critical
description: Your critical hits permanently deafen the target. A Fortitude save reduces this to 1 round.

name: Blinding Critical
description: Your critical hits permanently blind the target. A Fortitude save reduces this to dazzled for 1d4 rounds.

name: Stunning Critical
description: Your critical hits stun the target for 1d4 rounds. A Fortitude save reduces this to staggered for 1d4 rounds.

name: Exhausting Critical
description: Your critical hits make the target exhausted.

name: Critical Mastery
description: Apply the effects of two critical feats to a critical hit instead of one.

name: Mounted Archery
description: Halve the penalty for ranged attacks while mounted.

name: Ride-By Attack
description: While mounted and charging, move, strike, and keep moving, without provoking from the foe you attack.

name: Spirited Charge
description: Your mounted charge deals double damage with a melee weapon (triple with a lance).

name: Trample
description: While mounted, your overrun targets can't avoid you, and your mount gets a hoof attack against any foe you knock down.

name: Unseat
description: A lance charge that hits can also make a free bull rush to knock a mounted foe off its mount.

name: Point-Blank Shot
description: +1 bonus on attack and damage rolls with ranged weapons against targets within 30 feet.

name: Far Shot
description: Take only a -1 penalty per range increment instead of -2.

name: Precise Shot
description: No -4 penalty for shooting or throwing at a foe engaged in melee.

name: Improved Precise Shot
description: Your ranged attacks ignore the AC bonus from anything less than total cover and the miss chance from anything less than total concealment.

name: Pinpoint Targeting
description: As a standard action, make one ranged attack against which the target gets no armor, natural armor, or shield bonus to AC. You can't have moved this round.

name: Shot on the Run
description: As a full-round action, move up to your speed and make one ranged attack at any point during the movement.

name: Rapid Shot
description: On a full attack with a ranged weapon, fire one extra time at your highest bonus, with a -2 penalty on all attacks.

name: Manyshot
description: On a full attack with a bow, your first attack fires two arrows. If it hits, both hit.

name: Quick Draw
description: Draw a weapon as a free action, and throw weapons at your full rate of attacks.

name: Rapid Reload
subject: Weapon
description: Choose hand, light, or heavy crossbow. Reload it much faster (a free action for hand and light, a move action for heavy). Needs proficiency with that crossbow, which isn't checked yet.
